plan.title: release:run (#6845 S2): publish gates accept only the run's grant, bound to the merged tree and the cut base

narratives.Description: The tag gate (release/closed-verb-gate.ts, called from release/finish.ts) and the draft-flip gate (release-publish/pipeline.ts) accept any active release-publish grant for the version, and the finish step does not compare the parent of the merged release commit M with the cut base B. This story adds an optional run binding (the grant id that release:run recorded, and B) that makes both gates evaluate only that grant with target <version>@<tree>, with the tree read from M or from the commit the remote tag peels to, and makes the finish step refuse unless the sole parent of M is B. Release notes and the upgrade banner are read from M. Without the binding, release --finish and release:publish behave as today. This is S2 of the #6845 split and has no dependencies.
narratives.Overview:
The release tag gate and the draft-flip gate accept any active `release-publish` grant for the version, and the finish step does not check that the merged release commit sits directly on the cut base. An up-front approval for `deft release:run` (#6845) needs both gates to accept only the run's own grant, bound to the tree read from the merged commit, and needs the release notes read from that commit. In the clauses, B is the cut base (the fetched delivery-branch tip), T is the tree of the release commit and M is the merged release commit.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Content-bound gates. Under the run, the tag gate and the draft-flip gate evaluate only the `release-publish` grant whose id the run recorded, with target `<version>@<tree>`. The tree is read from M for the tag gate and from the commit the remote tag peels to for the draft flip, never from the run record. Any other grant, including one with empty surfaces, does not satisfy them, and a version-only target does not match. The `DEFT_ALLOW_RELEASE_PUBLISH=1` env bypass keeps its break-glass meaning.
- [ ] Given only a version-only `release-publish` grant, when the tag gate runs, then it refuses and no tag is created.
- [ ] Given a merged release commit whose tree is not T and another active `release-publish` grant with empty surfaces, when the tag gate runs under the run, then it refuses and no tag is pushed.
- [ ] Given a PR that lands ahead of the release PR, when the finish step runs, then it refuses before the tag and the run stops and names the break-glass recovery.
- [ ] Given PRs that land ahead and leave the tree of B unchanged, so that M has tree T and no leftover entries, when the finish step runs or `--resume` would push a local-only tag, then it refuses because the parent of M is not B.
- [ ] Given draft release notes, then the notes and the upgrade banner are read from M.

Refs #6845

narratives.UserStory: As a release operator, I want the tag and draft-flip gates to accept only the grant my release run minted for the exact merged tree and cut base, so that an unattended run cannot tag or publish bytes I did not approve.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
- packages/core/src/release/types.ts: add ReleaseRunBinding { grantId, expectedBase } and an optional runBinding on ReleaseConfig; release-publish/pipeline.ts imports it, so release-publish/types.ts stays unchanged.
- packages/core/src/release/closed-verb-gate.ts: with a binding, the tag gate keeps only the bound grant id and evaluates target <version>@<tree of M>; any other grant, a grant with empty surfaces or a version-only target refuses; DEFT_ALLOW_RELEASE_PUBLISH=1 keeps its break-glass meaning.
- packages/core/src/release/finish.ts: with a binding, after checkMergeCommit resolve the sole parent of M and refuse unless it is B, before the tag is created; export that parent check so the S4 resume runs it before pushing a local-only tag; read the tree of M with git rev-parse and pass it to the gate; read the upgrade banner from M with git show (CHANGELOG text is already read from M).
- packages/core/src/release/changelog.ts: prependUpgradeBanner takes the banner text (or a commit-scoped reader) so the finish step can supply it from M.
- packages/core/src/release-publish/pipeline.ts: evaluateReleasePublishGate and runPublish take an optional run grant id; the draft flip reads the tree the remote tag v<version> peels to and evaluates <version>@<tree> against only that grant.
- Refusals are returned failures with string reason text. No new throw sites and no new numeric constants; exit codes reuse EXIT_* from release/constants.ts.
- Reading of clause 2: the version-only refusal applies under the run binding. The manual release --finish path keeps accepting a version-only grant until S5 (#6878) replaces the runbook.
- Tests: finish.test.ts, closed-verb-gate.test.ts, release-publish/pipeline.test.ts and changelog.test.ts cover each clause.
